subject: Trial acceleration checklist, success metrics & kickoff asks
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightglass.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Trial acceleration checklist, success metrics & kickoff asks

Hi Oliver / Sandra —

Great talk this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum heading into the pilot: 

1) Proposed pilot scope (3 weeks):
   - Ingest a representative subset (50k queries) of your anonymized activity logs.
   - Run parallel inference on current infra vs Redwood hosted small pool to validate latency and unit cost.
   - Evaluate quality on the annotated set you mentioned (500 labeled cases).

2) Draft success metrics (please confirm / adjust):
   - Latency: P95 inference latency < 150ms for the primary flow (target: 30% improvement vs baseline).
   - Cost: Token/inference unit cost reduction >= 2x vs current; track cost-per-inference and dollars/hour.
   - Accuracy/regression: model output quality measured against the 500-case set; no more than 5% degradation on high-priority intents.

3) Evaluation plan & ownership:
   - Redwood: setup, model routing, performance dashboards, and KV/prefix caching config (Owner: Ben Carter).
   - BrightGlass: provide sample logs, annotated set, and security point-of-contact for questionnaire (Owner: Oliver/Sandra).
   - Joint: weekly sync and a 15-min mid-pilot checkpoint to iterate on batch size and request routing.

4) Immediate asks to keep timeline:
   - Access: upload sample dataset to the shared Drive link by EOD 11/19.
   - Security: point us to the person who will complete the short security checklist (SOC2 export + retention policy doc).
   - SSO/KMS: confirm whether you want Redwood-managed keys or to bring your own KMS (we can support both).

5) Proposed kickoff: 11/24 at 10:00am PT (30–45 minutes) — runbook and access checklist review.

I attached a quick trial plan outline to this message. If the success metrics above look OK, Ben will share a short evaluation rubric and we'll open a JIRA ticket to track runbook items.

Thanks — aiming to get everything green by next Tuesday so we can start the 3-week run the week of 11/30 if we need to.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: redwood_trial_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightglass.ai>

Date: 2026-11-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial acceleration checklist, success metrics & kickoff asks

Thanks Jasmine — helpful summary. Quick replies inline: 

- Scope & timeline: 3-week pilot sounds right. We can get the 50k anonymized rows ready.
- Success metrics: latency target makes sense; cost target is ambitious but important — we'll validate baseline numbers and share by 11/19.
- Accuracy: the 500-case annotated set exists; I will have Sandra upload it.

Two questions from our infra/ops side: 
1) Can Redwood run the pilot on hosted capacity with data staying in our region (we're in us-west)?
2) For KMS, we'd prefer to use our existing cloud KMS if possible — what's the minimal integration effort?

We are available for a kickoff on 11/24 at 10am PT. I'll aim to have the dataset and baseline cost numbers to you before then.

--
Oliver Grant
Head of Data Engineering | BrightGlass Analytics
oliver@brightglass.ai

Subject: Re: Trial acceleration checklist, success metrics & kickoff asks

Oliver / Jasmine —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. A few concrete things from the Redwood side to make the evaluation unambiguous:

Evaluation rubric (summary):
- Latency: collect P50/P90/P95 across identical traffic slices; we will run a 24-hour steady-state window + three burst tests.
- Throughput/cost: measure tokens/sec and cost-per-token with batching enabled/disabled; estimate projected monthly cost at your 95th percentile.
- Quality: run the 500-case set and compute intent-level F1; flag any high-severity regressions for manual review.
- Reliability: track error rate and tail retries; target <0.5% error for primary flow.

Runbook & owners (action items):
- Redwood (Ben): deploy trial config, instrumentation, Grafana dashboards, and initial A/B routing to your baseline model.
- BrightGlass (Oliver/Sandra): upload dataset + sample auth credentials for SFTP/Drive (we prefer Drive link).
- Security (Grace): we'll send the minimal SOC2 checklist and a KMS integration doc.

Attachments & tracking: I attached the evaluation_rubric.md (checklist you can sign off on). I'll open JIRA SUP-4981 to track access, SSO/KMS integration, and the DocuSign MAP.

Quick note on hosted vs dedicated: For this size pilot, hosted in us-west is easiest and fastest (no infra commit). If you prefer dedicated, we can scope that in parallel but it adds 1–2 weeks to readiness.

I'll plan to have dashboards and the JIRA ticket by EOD tomorrow so we have a single place to track blockers.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

[Attachment: evaluation_rubric.md (md)]
